findings.failure_scenario: A plain git add -A / commit -a records only the staged deletions. On a clean checkout the worldserver built from the committed loader selects a.max_ready_runes on a DB that never received 2026_09_23_50. The rotation query fails, no profiles load, and the tests that reference the sql/custom/world paths fail.
findings.summary: Commit hazard, not a code defect: *.sql in sql/custom/world is git-ignored, so the six new or promoted migrations (10, 20, 50, 51, 52, 60) are untracked while the tracked staged copies of 10 and 20 show as deleted. They must be force-added (git add -f), as 2026_09_23_40/41 were.

findings.failure_scenario: An operator reverting DPS-065 from the SQL file alone finds no reverse and must reconstruct it from the test.
findings.summary: The promoted Balance migration has no in-file reverse block, unlike the other five and unlike sql/custom/staged/README.md ('Each file carries its reverse'). The exact reverse exists only as REVERSE_SQL in tests/test_balance_moving_moonfire.py (the sql/custom/rollback file it names does not exist). The forward rows are correct: byte-identical to the staged file, NOT EXISTS-guarded, enabled balance_druid dps only, moving-only, bucket 14.

findings.failure_scenario: A later run of the full smoke file reports this failure and it gets misattributed to the moving-cast change.
findings.summary: An earlier failing test outside the two known failures: test_combat_keeps_high_priority_movement_and_selects_instant_dps. The diff's edit (pinning HasEffectiveCastTime at line 5408) passes, but the test still fails at the unrelated assertion 'state->MovementLease.ExpiresAtMs > nowMs' in ExecuteProfileCombatAction. It fails identically on a HEAD export, so it is not caused by this diff.

findings.failure_scenario: A healer with a proc-instant heal (e.g. Nature's Swiftness) is still rejected or stopped while moving, and an attached bot blocks movement for one tick after a proc-instant cast. The result is lost throughput, never an unlawful cast.
findings.summary: Remaining base-CalcCastTime movement decisions outside the three shared predicates: BotController.cpp:237 (attached-controller castTimeMovementBlocked), BotWorldPopulationMgrCombatSupport.cpp:218 (movement_requires_instant_heal) and :348 (heal-submission stop), BotWorldPopulationMgrNativeAction.cpp:316 (combat-res stop), BotWorldPopulationMgrValidationGroupHeal.cpp:67. All are more cautious than the client, none calls RejectMovingCandidate, YieldsToProtectedMovement or StopUncoveredMovingCast, and none is on the DPS profile path. BotActionExecutor.cpp:378 keeps a base pre-filter but defers to StopUncoveredMovingCast's effective check, so it is consistent.

findings.failure_scenario: None functional; one extra spell-mod scan per candidate per decision.
findings.summary: Duplicate preview: candidate.CastTimeMs, from ProfileSpellCastTimeMs in the candidate builder, already holds the identical effective cast time for the same resolved SpellInfo, so 'candidate.CastTimeMs > 0' would be equivalent. Behaviour is correct.

findings.failure_scenario: A strict diff-scope check against owned_files flags the two staged deletions as out-of-scope edits.
findings.summary: owned_files omits sql/custom/staged/world/2026_09_23_10_blood_outbreak_disease_upkeep.sql and ..._20_balance_moving_moonfire.sql, which the diff deletes as the other half of the promotion (the Outbreak test asserts the staged copy is gone).

findings.failure_scenario: A later rotation review misreads Blood Tap or ERW as always-on and proposes a redundant gate.
findings.summary: Not owned: _TRINITY_GATE_COLUMNS here and TYPED_COLUMNS in build_phase4_rotation_contract.py do not list max_ready_runes, so rotation-review exports will show the Blood Tap and ERW rows as ungated by rune count.

limits: No build, link or live run: the DPS effect per actor and the acceptance evidence (Outbreak >= 3, Blood Tap >= 2, ERW 1, Pyroblast!/Combustion, moving Starsurge) are unverified.
I did not re-verify the combat-log and trace figures quoted in the migration headers (DS gate rejections, WCL cast times, 35.043 yd anchor); only the spell facts and score math were checked.

The preview passes no Spell, so no charge is taken, unless the player's spell-mod-taking spell is set. That exposure already exists in ProfileSpellCastTimeMs, and no bot hook runs inside Spell::cast's mod-taking windows.
The preview can differ from the real cast only for a charge-using aura left at 0 charges before removal; the native cast would then fail harmlessly with SPELL_FAILED_MOVING.

On a fresh database, name order applies 10 before 40/41. The final state (v31, ERW note) matches the incremental path, but the Outbreak reverse block restores the profile note only on the incremental path.
Live database state was read at review time and may change before the build.
